test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate active form of the given sentence.**

A bed time story was made by him for me every night.

options.text: He has been making a bed time story for me every night.
He has made a bed time story for me every night.
He made a bed time story for me every night.
I made a bed time story for him every night.

solution:
The correct answer is:** He made a bed time story for me every night.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the passive form and in the Simple past tense and we need to change it to the active form.
 
• The Simple past in the passive voice has the following form: Subject + was/were + past participle + by object__
 
• The Simple past in the active voice has the following form: __Subject + past participle + object__
 __
 
• Passive: *A letter was written by him.*
 
• Active: *He wrote a letter.*
 
 

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

​Correct Active Voice:__* **He made a bed time story for me every night.*
